landmark

The Wondergat is a deep natural sinkhole plunging into the rocky terrain near Twyfelfontein.

museum

This open-air museum showcases the traditional culture, crafts, and bush skills of the indigenous Damara people.

landmark

Organ Pipes
landmark

The Organ Pipes are a striking geological formation of angular basalt columns formed by ancient volcanic activity.

landmark

Ez a sziklás domb sötét, megszilárdult lávafolyásairól híres, amelyek a napfényben erősen perzseltnek tűnnek.

Burnt Mountain
landmark
